Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position in Barcelona. With over a year of hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and content strategy, I am excited about the opportunity to help clients grow their businesses through innovative online marketing solutions.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. My background in front-end development gives me a unique technical edge in understanding how websites work and how to optimize them for performance.

I am fluent in English (C1) and Turkish (native), and I am currently improving my Dutch (B1). I am eager to relocate to Barcelona and take advantage of the relocation package offered. I am confident that my skills in digital marketing, sales, and customer relationship building make me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at your company in Barcelona. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for helping businesses succeed online, I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm align perfectly with the requirements of this role.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained over a year of hands-on experience in digital marketing, specializing in SEO, content creation, and website management. I have successfully managed on-page SEO for client websites, conducted keyword research, and written keyword-targeted blog content that has improved organic visibility and search rankings. Additionally, I have built and maintained client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme, ensuring they are user-friendly and optimized for performance.

One of my proudest achievements is my personal project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits, which significantly improved the site's visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my ability to take initiative, learn new tools, and deliver measurable results.

I am fluent in English (C1) and Turkish (native), and I am currently improving my Dutch (B1). I am eager to relocate to Barcelona and immerse myself in the vibrant culture while contributing to your team. I am a goal-oriented, proactive individual with excellent communication and negotiation skills, and I am excited about the opportunity to advise clients on digital marketing strategies and build long-term relationships.

Thank you for considering my application. I would love the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)

- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools

- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
